style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial diagram on warm cream paper, deep navy line work with small rust accents. A pyramid divided into horizontal layers labelled, bottom to top, COLABORADORES, RESPONSABLE, DIRECTOR, DIRECCIÓN. On the LEFT half, broad bands of fine detail at the base narrow as upward arrows pass through each layer, captioned COMPRESIÓN, with a small note near the apex reading INFORMACIÓN DE BASE, COMPRIMIDA. On the RIGHT half, a single arrow leaves the apex and fans out, widening downward into a row of labelled unit boxes FINANZAS, OPERACIONES, SERVICIO at the base, captioned CONTEXTUALIZACIÓN, with a small note reading ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EL LUNES? Calm, architectural, legible labels. No logos, no people. All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
